method: Statements match MATH after decoding literal escapes, removing the A–E answer-choice suffix, normalizing TeX spacing/style commands, fractions, multiplication notation, braces and whitespace. Digits, letters, operators and punctuation are retained. Only unambiguous topic matches are retained. MATH Algebra and Intermediate Algebra map to algebra; Counting & Probability maps to combinatorics; Geometry and Number Theory map directly. Prealgebra and Precalculus excluded. No keyword-based or fuzzy matches.
